title: Agent Forge Metadata Source Manifest
description: Describes one independently consumable Agent Forge metadata catalog. A source is metadata only; it is not a plugin binary mirror.

schemaVersion.description: Breaking version of the source-manifest contract.

sourceId.description: Stable machine-readable identity, for example agent-forge:dsh:plugin.

name.description: Human-readable source name; not the stable identity.

agentId.description: Agent projection covered by this source. Null denotes an all-agent catalog view.

type.description: Agent Forge package category represented by this source.

baseUrl.description: Base URL containing the manifest and its index.

index.description: POSIX path to the index, relative to baseUrl. Usually index.json.

revision.description: Immutable catalog revision shared by this manifest, index, and generated assets.

generatedAt.description: Time at which this manifest was generated.

updatedAt.description: Time at which the catalog data was last changed.

mirrorOf.description: Canonical sourceId mirrored by this source. Omit or set null for a canonical source.

priority.description: Consumer selection priority; lower values are preferred.

official.description: Whether the operator declares this an official endpoint; not a security guarantee.

indexChecksum.description: Optional digest of the bytes at the index path.

sourceMirrors.description: Known endpoints serving this catalog revision; these are metadata sources, not plugin distributions.

relatedSources.description: Other catalog endpoints related to this source, such as regional fallbacks.
